tasks.short: Select stored tools and materials and carry them to the work site

steps.what: Read or clarify the carpenter's actual request for tools, equipment or materials and destination
inputs: carpenter's actual item request and work location

steps.what: Locate and select the actual requested tools, equipment or materials from storage, checking identity, quantity and condition
inputs: actual stored items and existing storage labels

steps.what: Transport the actual selected tools, equipment or materials to the work site and place them where the carpenter needs them
outputs: actual items delivered to work site

tasks.design: Retain actual request clarification, physical item selection and transport with the helper. A {OTHER} storage-location application would need real maintained locations and capture; this ordinary labelled-storage episode already uses physical labels and has no separate inventory transaction to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires finding, checking and moving actual physical items.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific native setting or deterministic software changes the observed physical selection/transport steps in this scenario.
tasks.still_hard: Correct item condition, quantity, load and safe route depend on actual materials and surroundings.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that the labelled item is damaged or unsuitable before taking it to the carpenter.

ambition.what: No extra material-handling capacity or equipment change claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new system or access proposed

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selecting and carrying stored construction items requires physical identification, condition checks and handling.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional helper effort for an actual request and labelled storage, not a measured baseline or prompt prior.
The carpenter supplies the actual request/destination; existing storage labels identify locations. The helper performs all item checks in s2; no free structured live inventory is assumed.

Native location views and pick templates were considered. The actual lookup/selection is separate from clarification and transport; no required record write, report or discrete send exists in this ordinary episode.
An actual checkout or stock transaction, if present at a site, would need its own entry/commit effort; it is not invented to create a saving here.
All actual steps remain fully retained. Gross/net saving and incremental upkeep are zero because no software change is proposed.
unknowns: Actual storage-location system or checkout requirement
research_questions: Does the actual site have repeated location lookup or an item checkout transaction that can be assessed separately from physical transport?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unchanged actual request clarification, physical selection and transport; no record work is hidden in the live steps.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Identify correct tool and material condition
role.ambitious_version: The helper continues physical selection and delivery; no change in role authority or capacity is supported by this task.
